# Verification Task Authoring

## 9. Gates Name Their Owner

Every command in a Before/After block names the owner who runs it — runner or
orchestrator. An unattributed command invites a double execution.

## 10. Gate Discipline

A gate exists to answer one question: did the work happen? It answers that
question only if its value differs before and after the work.

This section does not yet carry the preservation-marker rule; the task below adds it.
